{{Top|leg}}
A '''wash-up kit''' was a personal grooming tool. It was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] [[Interrogator (occupation)|interrogators]] as part of their interrogation technique. When using a method called "acceleration"&mdash;wherein they manipulated the prisoner into perceiving time was elapsing faster&mdash;interrogators used the wash-up kit to always appear washed and groomed to help the illusion of time passing. They were used in conjunction with a [[portable uniform fresher]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
